name: The Perenolde Tiara
summary: Count Remington Ridgewell sends mercenaries into the Ruins of Alterac for a lost heirloom. The Perenolde Tiara once adorned Alterac's royal family and now rests with an ogre mage.

sections.title: A Relic of a Ruined Kingdom
sections.body: Alterac's royal family wore an emerald-set tiara made by master dwarven jewelers in Ironforge. During the Second War, King Aiden Perenolde betrayed the Grand Alliance and joined the Orcish Horde. Alterac was conquered and collapsed. When Alterac City fell, many royal treasures vanished among the snowy rubble of the Alterac Mountains.

sections.title: The Miser in the Ruins
sections.body: Grel'borg the Miser, an ogre mage among the Crushridge ogres, holds the tiara in the ruins. He searches the broken stones for baubles and abandoned wealth. Count Remington Ridgewell, a collector of historical oddities in Stormwind City, learns the tiara survived. He hires mercenaries to enter ogre-held territory, defeat Grel'borg, and return the jewel to his gallery.

faq.answer: The Perenoldes were the royal family of Alterac, the human realm in the north. During the Second War, King Aiden Perenolde collaborated with the invading Orcish Horde to spare his kingdom. The Alliance of Lordaeron uncovered his treachery, occupied Alterac, dismantled its throne, and left the kingdom to lawlessness and ruin.
Master jewelers in Ironforge made the tiara and set it with emeralds. It was a sign of nobility and wealth for Alterac's ruling family.
Grel'borg the Miser holds the tiara. The ogre mage scavenges the snowy Ruins of Alterac for treasures left behind by the ruined human city.

faq.q: Why does Count Remington Ridgewell want the tiara?
faq.answer: Count Remington Ridgewell wants the tiara for his private collection. The wealthy noble and antiquarian lives in Stormwind City and hires mercenaries to retrieve lost treasures from perilous places across Azeroth.

faq.q: Where are the Ruins of Alterac located?
faq.answer: The Ruins of Alterac lie in the northern Alterac Mountains, north of the Hillsbrad Foothills and the Durnholde region. Crushridge ogres and Syndicate outlaws now infest the abandoned city.

faq.q: What happens to the tiara after you recover it?
faq.answer: After Count Ridgewell receives the muddy, tarnished heirloom, professional restorers clean and polish it. He then mounts it as a showpiece in his collection.

angles.text: For humans of the Alliance, the tiara recalls Alterac's betrayal during the Second War, when its human royalty sided with the Horde against their own kin.
Ironforge's master jewelers crafted the tiara. Their fine work endured even as a human kingdom fell.
By traveling north into the lawless Alterac Mountains, you can clear out dangerous Crushridge ogres and recover priceless historical artifacts for Stormwind's nobility.
